name: Ferrogate Night Bus
description: A reduced-service bus running midnight to 5 AM routes through Tier 1-2 districts. The Night Bus is the transportation of last resort — underfunded, understaffed, running on routes that the day service abandoned decades ago. The drivers are either saints or desperate, the passengers are shift workers, drunks, and people with nowhere else to go. The buses themselves are the oldest in the fleet, too worn out for day service. Something about the Night Bus attracts stories — every regular rider has one.
propulsion: Electric, battery-only (catenary lines powered down at night)
speed: 20 km/h average (no rush hour, but no maintained roads either)
cost: Φ1 per ride (same as day service, rarely collected)
autonomy: Human driver only. Night route automation was defunded.
common_usage: Night shift workers, overnight travel, the desperate, the lost.
story_hooks: A Night Bus driver swears they've been picking up the same passenger every night for a year — at a stop that was demolished six months ago
The Night Bus route passes through a dead zone where all communications drop for exactly four minutes, and something always happens during those four minutes
